City Council Meeting
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA City Council Meeting
November 8, 2016 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

REPLACEMENT GENERATOR FOR CITY EVENTS â€“ APPROVAL OF PURCHASE - It is recommended the City Council approve the purchase of the MQ Power Series WhisperWatt Generator offered by Cummins Pacific in the amount of $81,950, as provided through the CMAS Program, to replace the current generator for City events.
Item 6.2 - Approval for Purchase
6.3
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated November 8, 2016 in the total amount of $1,594,953.98.
Item 6.3 Warrant Register

CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2015-15, RESIDENTIAL STREETS SLURRY SEAL NORTH OF FOSTER ROAD AND SOUTH OF IMPERIAL HIGHWAY FROM OCASO AVENUE TO EASTERLY CITY LIMITS - ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by Doug Martin Contracting Company, Inc.; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the contract.
Item 6.4 CIP No. 2015-15
6.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2016-08, WROUGHT IRON FENCE REPAINTING AT WINDERMERE, BEHRINGER, FRONTIER AND OAK CREEK PARKS â€“ REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2016-08, Wrought Iron Fence Repainting at Windermere, Behringer, Frontier and Oak Creek Parks, to A. J. Fistes Corporation in the amount of $14,637; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost including construction, and construction testing and inspection.
Item 6.5 CIP No. 2016-08

LEASE AGREEMENT WITH PRODUCTSGO, LLC FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 14515 ALONDRA BOULEVARD - It is recommended the City Council approve the Lease Agreement and Memorandum of Lease and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreements and any amendments on behalf of the City.
Item 6.6 Lease of City Property
7.
PUBLIC HEARING
7.1
CONSIDERATION OF DRAFT CITY COUNCIL DISTRICT MAPS – It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing to gather public input on the draft City Council district maps and select a map establishing the boundaries and identification number of each district.
Item 7.1 Draft Council District Maps
8.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
8.1
ORDINANCE NO. 684 PROVIDING FOR THE ELECTION OF MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL BY FIVE DISTRICTS, ESTABLISHING THE BOUNDARIES AND IDENTIFICATION NUMBER OF EACH DISTRICT, ESTABLISHING THE ELECTION ORDER OF EACH DISTRICT AND ADDING CHAPTER 2.02 TO THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE - It is recommended the City Council adopt Ordinance No. 684 providing for the election of members of the City Council by five districts, establishing the boundaries and identification number of each district, establishing the election order of each district and adding Chapter 2.02 to the La Mirada Municipal Code.
Item 8.1 Ordinance No. 684
8.2
RESOLUTION NO. 16-37 CALLING FOR THE HOLDING OF A GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION TO BE HELD ON TUESDAY, MARCH 7, 2017, FOR THE ELECTION OF CERTAIN OFFICERS AS REQUIRED BY THE PROVISIONS OF THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA RELATING TO GENERAL LAW CITIES – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 16-37 calling for the holding of a General Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, March 7, 2017, for the election of certain officers as required by the provisions of the laws of the State of California relating to General Law cities.
Item 8.2 Resolution No. 16-37
8.3
INTERIM ORDINANCE NO. 685-U PROHIBITING ALL COMMERCIAL NON-MEDICAL MARIJUANA ACTIVITY IN THE CITY OF LA MIRADA, PROHIBITING OUTDOOR MARIJUANA CULTIVATION ON PRIVATE RESIDENCES AND DECLARING THE URGENCY THEREOF - It is recommended the City Council adopt Interim Ordinance No. 685-U prohibiting all commercial non-medical marijuana activity in the City of La Mirada, prohibiting outdoor marijuana cultivation on private residences and declaring the urgency thereof, by title only, and waiver further reading.
Item 8.3 Ordinance No. 685-U
8.4
FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 686 ESTABLISHING PROCEDURES AND REQUIREMENTS FOR CONDUCTING MOTION PICTURE FILMING, AND AMENDING TITLE 4 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE - It is recommended the City Council introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 686 establishing procedures and requirements for conducting motion picture filming, and amending Title 4 of the La Mirada Municipal Code, by title only, and waive further reading.
Item 8.4 Ordinance No. 686
